artworks.title: Cardinal de Bouillon
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man facing forward with his head slightly tilted to his left. He has wavy shoulder-length hair, a smooth complexion, arched eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a rounded nose, and a faint smile. He wears a historical garment with a white collar and textured fabric over his shoulders. There are no visible accessories. The background is a dark oval, encircled by an ornate border with inscriptions.

artworks.title: Cardinal de Bouillon
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person positioned with their upper half facing slightly left. The person has wavy, shoulder-length hair and gentle facial features with a straight nose and full lips. They wear a garment with a wide collar and a cross necklace. The background features an ornate oval frame with Latin inscriptions and a textured backdrop. Below the portrait is a decorative element with an intricate coat of arms.

artworks.title: Godefroi-Maurice, Duc de Bouillon
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person from the chest up. The person is facing slightly to the side, with long hair falling past their shoulders. They have a smooth complexion, a straight nose, and a serious expression. The individual is wearing historical armor with large rivets, a draped cloth or sash, and a decorative neck collar. No jewelry is visible. The portrait is enclosed in an oval frame, below which is a coat of arms featuring two lions, a shield, and a crown. The background consists of detailed, engraved lines.

artworks.title: Frederic-Maurice, Duc de Bouillon
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a man's body. He is positioned facing slightly to his right, looking towards the viewer. The man's facial features include a prominent mustache and a goatee, with medium-length wavy hair that falls around his shoulders. He is wearing a dark, metallic-looking armor with a high, rounded collar adorned with lace and a sash draped over one shoulder. The background is an ornate oval frame with text inscribed around the edge, and below the oval is a decorative panel with a coat of arms and text in French.

artworks.title: Pierre Bouchu
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in formal clergy attire seated with a calm expression. His face is visible, turned slightly towards the viewer, with short hair that closely follows the shape of his head. He wears a high-collared garment and a cross pendant around his neck. The portrait is encased within an oval frame with script around it, set against a background of delicately engraved lines.

artworks.title: Chancellor Boucherat
artworks.description: In the image, there is an upper body portrait of a person facing forward. The individual has curly hair, wears elegant clothing, and is surrounded by an ornate oval frame against a dark backdrop.

artworks.title: Chancellor Bouchert
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a man's body captured in a forward-facing position. The man has a round face with prominent cheekbones and a slightly downturned mouth framed by full, curly hair that extends down to his shoulders. His clothing consists of a dark, formal garment featuring a wide, white collar that extends across his chest and is adorned with a decorative, patterned tassel or brooch. The background is simple with a circular border encircling the portrait, featuring engraved text that frames the image.

artworks.title: Jacques-Benigne Bossuet
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man with medium-length, wavy hair and facial features that include a composed expression with a small smile and a direct gaze. He is wearing a garment with a wide collar and a large cross pendant hanging from his neck. The background is a simple oval frame with Latin inscriptions surrounding him.

artworks.title: Francois Bosquet
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man shown from the chest up. He is positioned facing slightly towards the right, looking directly at the viewer. The man has a round face with prominent eyebrows, a short beard, and curly, shoulder-length gray hair that is neatly styled. He is wearing a clerical outfit, evident from the wide collar and the fitted robe or garment. Around his neck, he wears a long chain with a large cross pendant. The background of the image is plain and features a decorative oval frame surrounding the portrait, with Latin text inscribed in the border. Below the oval, there is a decorative crest or emblem.

artworks.title: Cardinal de Bonzi
artworks.description: The image portrays a man with curly light hair, wearing a dark robe and a skullcap. He has a serene expression with pronounced cheekbones and deep-set eyes, looking slightly to the left. The man is enclosed within an oval frame with a coat of arms below. The background features textured and linear designs.

artworks.title: Gilles Boileau
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the shoulders up. The man is facing forward with a slight turn to his right. He has a serious expression, a prominent nose, and a mustache. He has curly, shoulder-length hair and appears to be wearing a cap. The man is dressed in a dark garment with detailed embroidery and a large, white collar tied at the neck. The background is simple and monochrome, enclosed within an oval frame.

artworks.title: Marc Bochart
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest upwards. He is facing slightly to the side with a calm expression. He has distinct facial features including a mustache, beard, nose, and cheekbones. His hair is short and combed back. The man wears a garment with a high collar adorned with lace or embroidery. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The portrait is set in an oval frame within a detailed line work background. Below the oval frame is a decorative emblem with cherubic figures and a shield with a heart-like symbol. The background is composed of fine lines adding texture.

artworks.title: David Blondel
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man from the chest up. He has shoulder-length, wavy hair, a high forehead, pronounced cheekbones, a mustache, and a small goatee. He wears 17th-century clothing, including a dark coat with visible buttons and a white collar, as well as a decorative necktie. The engraving includes ornate details like an oval frame with inscriptions, ornamental text, and a coat of arms at the bottom center. The background features a textured pattern typical of engravings from that era.

artworks.title: Gilles Blondeau
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a portrait shown from the chest up. He is positioned with his body angled slightly to the left, facing the viewer. He has a long face with prominent features: a strong nose, thin lips, and focused eyes. His hair is shoulder-length, wavy, and parted in the middle, with a cap on his head. He is wearing a dark garment with a wide, white collar and a decorative clasp or brooch at the center. The portrait is enclosed in an oval frame, below which is a coat of arms with ornate design. The background has finely lined shading for depth.

artworks.title: Francoise Blanchart
artworks.description: The image features a classical portrait of a man shown from the chest up. He is posed facing the right and his gaze is slightly towards the viewer. The man has a composed expression with distinct facial features including a straight nose, full lips, and gentle gaze. His hair is neatly cut and appears gray or white. He is wearing a formal robe with a pleated texture and a cross pendant around his neck. The background is a dark oval shape and the image is bordered by an ornate oval frame with inscriptions in a classical style.

artworks.title: Charles Benoise
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up. He is facing slightly to the right, with shoulder-length wavy dark hair, a mustache, and a composed expression. He is wearing a dark buttoned garment and a robe with voluminous sleeves, along with a white collar and a knotted tie. The background shows an oval frame with a patterned design and fine lines, highlighting the man's figure. The frame includes a coat of arms with detailed embellishments.

artworks.title: Pompone II de Bellievre
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Charles Le Brun
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a portrait, depicted from the chest up, looking slightly to the side with his face turned towards the viewer. He has a detailed facial appearance with a mustache and a neat beard. His medium-length hair is styled in curls, falls to his shoulders, and he wears a small cap. He is dressed in opulent clothing with a fur stole draped around his shoulders. Below the image, there is an ornate crest or coat of arms. The background features a decorative oval frame with an inscription, creating a classic and elegant atmosphere.

artworks.title: Pompone II de Bellievre
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image shows a man facing forward, slightly turned to his left. He has sharp features, a pointed mustache, and a small goatee. His hair is curly and shoulder-length. He is wearing a luxurious garment with fur detailing wrapping around his shoulders. The clothing has striped patterns and rich textures. The background is a dark texture with an ornate border.

artworks.title: Francois, Duc de Beaufort
artworks.description: The image shows a man depicted from the mid-torso up. He is standing with his body slightly turned to one side while facing the viewer directly. His facial features include a long, narrow face with a pronounced nose, and thick eyebrows. He has long, curly hair that cascades down past his shoulders. He is dressed in elaborate clothing featuring a richly ornate armor with intricate detailing, over which a fabric with a finely embroidered lace collar is layered. The man is holding a baton or staff in one hand. The image is framed with an elaborate border of leaves and scrollwork. The background is a plain, subdued canvas.

artworks.title: Etienne-Jehannot de Bartillat
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust-length portrait of a person. The person is positioned slightly turned to their right and gazing forward towards the viewer. Their facial features include a prominent nose and a slight smile, with wavy, shoulder-length hair framing their face. They are wearing a garment with an intricately patterned lace collar. The portrait is bordered by an oval decorative frame with inscriptions in a classical style. The background within the oval is neutral. Surrounding the oval frame are additional decorative elements including a coat of arms at the bottom.

artworks.title: Antoine Barillon
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait showing the upper body of a man turned slightly to his left, gazing toward the viewer. The man has long, wavy hair that falls to his shoulders and facial hair that includes a mustache and a small beard. He wears a dark, long-sleeved robe with a wide, white collar. Surrounding the portrait is an oval frame with an inscription, and below it is a heraldic shield with a crown. The background of the image is filled with delicate linework that adds texture behind the man's head, contained within the oval frame.

artworks.title: Cardinal Antonio Barberini
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a man's torso, primarily from the chest upwards. The man is depicted in a seated position, turning slightly to his right while looking directly at the viewer. He has medium-length, wavy hair that frames his face and a distinct mustache and goatee. His facial features are rendered with detailed lines. He is wearing a high-collared garment with a large, decorated medal hanging on his chest. The portrait's setting features an ornate, octagonal frame that is intricately designed with linear patterns, and beneath the portrait, there is a crest-like emblem with a coat of arms and decorative elements. The background is composed of finely crosshatched lines.

artworks.title: Cardinal Antonio Barberini
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a man. He has medium-length wavy hair, a mustache, and a pointed beard. He wears a formal garment with a wide collar over a cloak. There is a star-shaped insignia on a chain at his chest. The man is enclosed within an intricately detailed oval frame with decorative ribbons and floral motifs. The background has a lined texture. Below the portrait, there is a coat of arms embedded into the architectural structure.

artworks.title: Cardinal Antonio Barberini
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the chest up, facing slightly to the viewer's left. His body is in a three-quarter view, with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has curly hair, a mustache, and wears a dark, formal robe with a wide collar and a tassel. He wears a chain with a star-shaped medal around his neck. The background features an oval frame with intricate patterns against a vertically lined texture.
